description: Portrait of O'Keeffe in a desert landscape standing in front of a white easel which holds her painting, "Pelvis Series, Red with Yellow;"  behind her is a blue sky with clouds and an outcropping of rocks;  she stands with her back to the camera and her head in profile, her hair is pulled back into a bun, her right arm  and hand supports the corner of the painting in viewer right and her left arm hangs at her side, she wears a black wrap dress and her favorite Hector Aguilar belt - a black suede and sterling silver Taxco belt from Mexico.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe with 'Pelvis Series, Red with Yellow
